(a) all low energy levels of a twisted geodedic flow with a spherically rational magnetic form carry periodic orbits; (b) the same is true for all energy levels of an autonomous Hamiltonian flow near a Morse-Bott, symplectic, non-degenerate extremum, provided the ambient manifold satisfies certain topological requirements; (c) the proof of (b) is obtained via a combination of Sturm theory and Floer homology.
